Turkish bombardment | Three children seriously injured in western Manbij countryside

Aleppo province: Three children from one family were seriously injured in Turkish bombardment in the past few hours on Tahnah village in western Manbij in eastern Aleppo countryside, where they were taken to Al-Barkal hospital in Manbij city for treatment.

Several frontlines in the eastern and western countryside of Manbij, within areas of the military council of Minbij, are witnessing a remarkable escalation recently by the Turkish forces and their proxies.

Earlier today, SOHR sources reported that factions of the Turkish-backed “National Army” carried out an infiltration operation on the frontline of Al-Boghaz village west of Minbij city east of Aleppo, which resulted in the eruption of violent clashes between the factions and the forces of the military council of Minbij, in which heavy weapons were used, where the latter managed to respond the attack after the violent clashes. Forces of the military council of Minbij also targeted two vehicles of the attacking factions, which led to their detonation, amid Information about dead and injured people.
In parallel, forces of the military council of Minbij shot down a Turkish kamikaze drone, a short time before, in Arab Hasan village in the countryside of Minbij, east of Aleppo.
